label: Format
name: format
hint: Leave blank for the weekly dashboard.

label: Look
name: look
hint: Leave blank for the new look. Both formats, the weekly dashboard and the classic summary, have the two looks. If Slack refuses a new block (invalid_blocks) that feature is left out and the post sent again, down to the old look if need be; the error says which block it did not like and look_used says what went out.

label: New look features
name: new_features
hint: Only used with the new look. Leave blank for all of: headers, tiles, charts, cards, tables, panels (comma separated). Pick some, e.g. cards,tables, or take one away with a minus, e.g. -charts. none gives the old look. (charts is the weekly post's chart; the classic summary has none.)

label: Banner image URL
name: header_image_url
hint: Optional. A banner shown above the weekly post. Must be a public image URL.

label: @mention people
name: mention_people
hint: Default off. Names people in the weekly moments with a real @mention, which notifies them. Off shows names in bold.

toggle_field.label: @mention people
toggle_field.name: mention_people
toggle_field.hint: Default off. Names people in the weekly moments with a real @mention, which notifies them. Off shows names in bold.

label: Add the reaction
name: seed_reaction
hint: Default on. Puts the reaction the closing line asks for on the post. Needs reactions:write; skipped with a warning without it.

label: Thread ts
name: thread_ts
hint: Leave blank to post to the channel.

label: Dry run
name: dry_run
hint: Build the message and return it without posting.

label: Save snapshot
name: save_snapshot
hint: Default on. Saves this run so the next post can say what changed. A dry run never saves.

label: Timezone offset (seconds)
name: tz_offset
hint: Seconds east of UTC, to decide what today is. Default -25200 (as spotter).
